messages:
Nina Lopez: Heads-up: weekly KPI deck flagged an inconsistency between the dashboard's "webinar-sourced demos" and HubSpot lead_source. Can we triage before Friday?
Samir Khan: saw it too. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/dashboards/weekly-marketing. The count for 'webinar -> demo' is 84 in the dashboard but HS shows 112.
Evelyn Park: likely an attribution window mismatch. Dashboard uses a 14-day lookback, HS source mapping is last-touch within 7 days. That will explain some delta.
Jules Martin: good catch. Which metric should we standardize on for the executive report? Last-touch is simpler but understates long-funnel webinar influence.
Nina Lopez: execs want clarity on channels that seed pipeline. Recommend we publish both: last-touch and algorithmic multi-touch, with a short note on methodology.
AnalyticsBot: Snapshot: webinars (registrations): 1,540; webinar->demo (dashboard 14d window): 5.5%; webinar->demo (HS last-touch 7d): 7.3%.
Samir Khan: also noticed a spike in organic demo attributions on 3/18. Could be a tagging regression from the staging redirect that was patched last week.
Evelyn Park: can someone run a quick cohort join to compare first-touch utm vs last-touch utm for demo conversions last 30 days? Prefer SQL so we can audit.
Jules Martin: I'll run it. Quick SQL:
```
SELECT first_touch_utm, last_touch_utm, COUNT(*) as demos
FROM leads
WHERE converted_to_demo = TRUE AND created_at >= '2026-02-20'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY demos DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
Jules Martin: initial run shows ~22% of demos have mismatched utm_source between first and last touch.
Kai Wu: that's significant. Suggest we add a `kpi_source` field that follows this logic: if multi-touch signal > threshold, mark as "influenced_by_webinar" else fall back to last-touch. Then surface both in dashboard.
Nina Lopez: timeline: we need a reconciled number for Friday all-hands and a permanent fix in the KPI pipeline. Proposed owners: Samir -> reconcile pipeline and produce reconciled CSV; Evelyn -> align HS mapping and routing; Jules -> run cohort queries and produce methodology note; Kai -> update dashboard to show side-by-side metrics.
Samir Khan: ok assigned. I'll export reconciled CSV by EOD tomorrow and add a field `kpi_source` for backfill.
Evelyn Park: will adjust HS source mapping to reference `kpi_source` when present, and keep existing fields for backward compatibility. ETA: tomorrow noon.
Jules Martin: will draft a 1-paragraph methodology blurb for the deck and put it in the marketing drive.
Nina Lopez: can we also add a weekly annotation layer to the dashboard so the execs see when methodology changes happen? Small UX ask but important for trust.
AnalyticsBot: Note added: pending annotation feature request ticket #MK-3019.
Kai Wu: I'll add the side-by-side cards (last-touch vs algorithmic) and a small tooltip explaining the calculation. ETA: Thursday lunchtime.
Nina Lopez: Perfect. We'll review the reconciled numbers in the Thursday PM KPI sync and lock the Friday slide. Thanks all. :sparkles:
